summary: Vroom, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its warehouse credit facility. The amendment extends the commitment termination date from July 2, 2026 to June 2, 2027, modifies financial covenants by increasing the maximum leverage ratio, simplifying the tangible net worth threshold, updating the performance trigger framework, and increasing the maximum advance rate. A performance guaranty was also entered by VFH. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine credit facility amendment.
